messages:
tz: Heads-up — saw a regression on canary for ampere + fused-attn. Prefill path latency down, but decode path up ~18% for mid-length sequences (~512-1024).

maria: Logs or profiler output?

tz: Quick summary from a local run and perf-bot: prefill kernel_time -12ms, decode kernel_time +22ms. NV counters show L2 miss rate spike during decode.

alex: Could be KV cache eviction thrash when mixed short/long requests interleave. Any trace of KV reinit/evict around decode?

tz: Yes — trace shows frequent cache invalidations and reuploads when concurrency >6. Repro command: `rdw-prof --model redwood-v1 --slen 768 --concurrency 8 --dur 60s`

sam: Is it a kernel-selection flip? Ampere fused kernel is great for <512, but if we switch at 512 -> 768 we might hit a kernel with worse memory behavior.

nidhi: We currently threshold at 512 for that selection. Given the eviction, maybe we should bias to the decode-friendly path earlier on Ampere (move threshold to 256) or make selection hardware-aware.

maria: Proposal: add a hardware-aware scoring for path picks. score = est_latency + alpha * est_cache_miss_penalty. Tune alpha per GPU family, and add hysteresis to avoid oscillation.

tz: Experiment plan: 1) reproduce with rdw-prof over multiple seeds 2) run kernel-matrix sweep (slen x concurrency x batch) 3) enable hw-score in canary for 24h 4) rollback on p99 >5% regression.

perf-bot: Summary: reproduced on canary. p50 decode +18%, p99 +11% for mixed-slen workload. Artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/ampere-mid-slen-1795555555.tar.gz

alex: I'll own the kernel-matrix runs. I'll implement a small hysteresis window in the bucket selector to avoid flip-flopping (e.g., require 200ms of stable gain before switching).

sam: Also recommend a KV soft-protect: pin most-recent prefixes for ~200ms under high concurrency to reduce eviction thrash. Cheap and low-risk.

tz: I'll draft the scoring prototype PR and attach perf-bot artifacts. Proposed config snippet:
```
# path selection config (prototype)
slen_buckets: [0,64,256,512,1024]
hw_scores:
  ampere:
    alpha: 0.7
    hysteresis_ms: 200
    prefer_decode_below: 256
```

maria: Sounds good. If we all agree, schedule canary with hw-score on target cluster at 04:00 UTC and monitor p50/p95/p99 + KV churn metrics.

alex: :thumbsup: tagging @sam @nidhi to review KV soft-protect impl details.

sam: I'll mock the pinning in the runtime and run quick local smoke tests.

tz: Thanks — will open the PR and ping channel when canary is scheduled.
